content: The Pomovirus genus is a group of viruses that does not belong to any established viral family. The virions are non-enveloped and exhibit an elongated, rod-shaped morphology. They measure between 100 to 300 nanometers in length and 18 to 20 nanometers in width. Both ends of the virions display helical spirals. The genome of the Pomovirus consists of a single, non-segmented, linear strand of positive-sense, single-stranded RNA.
